evidence: Modifies package acceptance and mempool eviction handling in src/validation.cpp to return TX_RECONSIDERABLE instead of TX_MEMPOOL_POLICY on immediate trimming
rationale: Prevents evicted package transactions from being improperly treated as permanent policy rejections. As the author notes, while 'not a major issue', immediate trimming under mempool limits previously resulted in 'unneeded censorship of someone low-balling package feerates' until the next block.
